entities.summary: Michael Dodd is an American retired professional beach volleyball player who attended San Diego State University. With his partner Mike Whitmarsh, he won the silver medal in the men's inaugural beach volleyball tournament at the 1996 Summer Olympics in Atlanta. Since winning silver in the 1996 Atlanta Olympics, he has worked the Olympic Games of 2000 as a beach analyst and 2004 as an indoor analyst for NBC. In 2008, Dodd coached AVP stars Jake Gibb and Sean Rosenthal in the Beijing Olympics. Dodd also captained Team USA to a win over Brazil's best players in the inaugural AVP World Challenge in 2009.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a two-time Olympic medalist and AVP World Challenge winner, Mike Dodd's achievements in beach volleyball have had a significant impact on the sport, inspiring future generations of players. His coaching experience and media work have also contributed to the growth and popularity of the sport.
